leadText: Volume 5 is the fifth volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.
plainText:
Volume 5 is the fifth volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version. 

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 15: Dancing Vivillon
Adventure 16: Burning Fletchinder
Adventure 17: Shooting Frogadier

==Party changes==

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
Y's "Fletchy" evolves into in PS571.
Y's "Croaky" evolves into in PS572.
